$schema_comment_: Materialised by gan-fix-planner at Phase 1; consumed by gan-fix-generator and gan-fix-evaluator every iteration. Sticky issue IDs follow GAN-FEATURE-SHARED.md "Issue ID convention" — feature-mode carries IDs verbatim from host feedback. Pair-mirrors (CT/UX/FE that share a single fix patch with a sibling) are kept as distinct queue items so each ID closure-tracks independently against its own observable.

queue.symptom: PATCH /api/plan/features/1/tracks/Frontend/stages/Development body {"stageOwnerUserId":null} returns 200 OK with the stage stageOwnerUserId unchanged. Same on PATCH .../tracks/{kind} body {"trackOwnerUserId":null}. Proto sentinel -1 works; JSON null no-ops. Live-verified at baseline SHA.
queue.root_cause: PatchFeatureTrackStagePayload binds stageOwnerUserId as JsonElement?. System.Text.Json deserialises JSON null to C# null on a nullable struct — DecodeOwnerField's `if (element is null) return (false, 0);` short-circuits identically for absent and JSON-null. Proto sentinel -1 is the only path that reaches the Number branch. The iter-5 fix attempt cannot survive STJ defaults regardless of converter on the inner int.

fix_options.label: Custom [JsonConverter] on a Tristate<int> wrapper — wrapper records IsPresent and Value independently; converter writes IsPresent=true Value=null for JSON null, IsPresent=false for absent. Map IsPresent=true Value=null → proto -1; IsPresent=true Value=n → proto n; IsPresent=false → don't set proto field.
fix_options.notes: 5 files: new Tristate<T> + JsonConverter (2), PatchFeatureTrackStagePayload + PatchFeatureTrackPayload swap field type (2), PlanRequestHelpers.DecodeOwnerField sig change (1). Cleanest separation; the wrapper is a reusable primitive for any future tri-state field. Verdict-005 §1 explicitly recommends this option.

fix_options.label: Bind body as Dictionary<string,JsonElement> (or raw JsonDocument) in the controller, manually inspect dict.ContainsKey("stageOwnerUserId") and dict["stageOwnerUserId"].ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Null, then route into a typed DTO.
fix_options.notes: Two-controller change; loses static typing on the request body; FluentValidation rules need to operate on the dict view too (or a hand-mapped intermediate). Heavier-handed than opt-1 but localised.

fix_options.label: Custom model-binder for JsonElement? that constructs a JsonElement with ValueKind=Null instead of returning C# null.
fix_options.notes: Risk: silently changes the meaning of JsonElement? for any future consumer of that type in the codebase. Spooky-action-at-a-distance. Verdict §1 implicitly avoids this by recommending opt-1.

fix_options.label: Drop the JSON-null clear public-contract gesture and require proto -1 sentinel on the wire — requires updating api-contract.md lines 24/53/108/119/279 and openapi.json descriptions. Contract bump post-freeze.
fix_options.notes: EXPLICITLY NOT RECOMMENDED in the source feedback ("NOT recommended unless options 1-3 all fail"). Triggers the SHARED auto-fail trigger "Contract bumped without RFC entry (post-iteration-1)" unless an RFC ships in the same patch. Listed for completeness only.

queue.symptom: Contract drift: api-contract.md §10.5 + lines 108/119 say JSON null clears the explicit owner; live BE silently no-ops on JSON null. The contract document and the running gateway disagree on the public-facing clear gesture.
queue.root_cause: Same as BE-005-01 — the public-contract field type does not record presence independently of value, so JSON null is indistinguishable from absent at the binding site.

queue.symptom: `npm --prefix OneMoreTaskTracker.WebClient run lint` reports 1 error at GanttPage.tsx:448:7 — `react-hooks/set-state-in-effect`: 'Calling setState synchronously within an effect can trigger cascading renders'. The iter-4 useRef-during-render anti-pattern was lifted to useState+useEffect, but the new effect synchronously calls setFailCount which the React-19 lint rule rejects.
queue.root_cause: GanttPage.tsx:445-451 has `useEffect(() => { if (error) setFailCount((c) => c + 1); else setFailCount(0); }, [error]);`. setState inside useEffect on error-state change is a derived value masquerading as side-effect.

queue.symptom: Same lint error as FE-005-01 from the UX/polish track view. Lint blocks the func-eval-contract DoD lint gate. Closes when FE-005-01 closes.

ESLint warns at InlineOwnerPicker.tsx:140 (handleKeyDown useCallback) — `react-hooks/exhaustive-deps`: missing dependencies 'allowInherit', 'resolveHighlighted', 'totalOptions'. The keyboard handler reads three values introduced for the inherit feature; if those change between renders the cached callback uses stale values.
queue.root_cause: The iter-5 inherit-option feature added new closures inside the keyboard handler without updating its dependency array; resolveHighlighted is also defined as a plain function each render, creating a new identity that would force exhaustive-deps to require either inlining or wrapping in useCallback.

queue.root_cause: GanttPage.tsx error-card branch renders a plain div; no ARIA live-region scaffolding.

queue.symptom: Same as FE-003-03 from the UX track. Persona-3 (Elena, screen-reader) cannot perceive load failures.
After a deterministic Zod schema-mismatch failure, the retry button keeps issuing the same failing request. No 'Schema mismatch — refresh required' affordance.
queue.root_cause: GanttPage's catch branch treats every failure as transient; no inspection of whether the failure is a deterministic schema violation (which retry cannot resolve) vs a transient network error.

func-eval-contract.md Flow 7 says 'at 1100px, internal-id column hides'. CSS uses `@media (max-width: 1099px)` so at 1100 px exactly the rule does NOT fire. Functionally acceptable (most viewport probes test 1024/1099) but pedantically the brief said 'at 1100'.
queue.root_cause: Off-by-one in the media query upper bound.

queue.symptom: selectStagesForKind is called inline on every render. As feature count grows past ~20 on a 1440 px viewport (perf headroom flagged in feature-report §Remaining Issues), the per-render cost compounds. Memoisation by [track.stages, track.kind] is a defensive 1-line change.
queue.root_cause: Missing useMemo wrapping a per-render computation that has stable inputs.
